title: NIT Patna Recruitment 2026 - Walk-in-Interview for Project Engineer Posts
description: The National Institute of Technology (NIT) Patna has announced the official notification for 2026. To fill up the vacancies for Project Engineer Jobs. Those candidates who have qualified in B.E./B. Tech in Civil Engineering can apply for the NIT Patna Recruitment 2026 . Here we include the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts. Interested and eligible aspirants can attend the interview at the given venue. For more ...
